verdict.rationale: The API docs mention an organization's 'region-specific domain', which implies multi-region SaaS hosting, but nothing in the pack explains choosing a region or what residency it guarantees. Self-hosting lets you run all of Sentry on your own server, giving full control over data location, but it is a minimal setup with no guarantees or dedicated support. Community reports note heavy resource demands for self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting a SaaS data region (e.g., US/EU) at org creation, residency/compliance guarantees, and how region choice interacts with AI features like Seer.
